implementation_boundary.core: Source-backed detected-event heat arithmetic with explicit profile, clock and equality/order policies; no implicit HP/score mutation.
implementation_boundary.adapter: Synthetic accepted/emitted projectile may stand in for detected shot only under named experimental provenance; rejected commands, empty-fire attempts and impacts do not independently add heat.
implementation_boundary.restrictions: No automatic yellow/red card creation. No import of older-season excess-heat damage. Do not preemptively suppress the shot that first crosses Q0. Keep lock causes separate.
implementation_boundary.not_implemented_here: This audit adds source documentation only, not code, tests, native binaries, publication, or external QA checks.
